)

    ["git", "commit", "-q", "-m", "m3: Deprecate module-level bump/finalize/format/parse functions"],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
print("Commit:", result.stdout, result.stderr)

# Check final log
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "log", "--oneline", "base..HEAD"],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
print("Final log:")
print(result.stdout)
